fallback: I know lots of things! Try asking 'tell me about pandas' or 'how do birds fly?'

reply_lines: Did you know stories started thousands of years ago around campfires? People told them out loud before pencils existed!
Pandas eat 12 hours a day, mostly bamboo. They're great climbers. They live in China!
The closest star to Earth is the Sun. Did you know? Stars are giant balls of glowing gas.
Birds fly because their wings push air down. Hollow bones make them light. Cool, right?
